subject: Short-term throughput lift request + volume rebate negotiation
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice@olivetech.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: ethan@olivetech.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term throughput lift for product launch

Camila,

We’re ramping up to our beta launch on July 20th and expect a spike in inference volume for roughly 72 hours as we onboard our first 10k users. Can Redwood temporarily raise our rate limit from 1.5M tokens/min to 4M tokens/min between July 19–21? We’d be fine with a short-term surcharge; however, we’d like to discuss a volume rebate if we cross 200M tokens this month.

Attached is last month’s usage (Jun). Please confirm feasibility and an estimate for the surcharge or rebate path.

Thanks,

Alice Monroe
VP, Product — Olive Tech
alice@olivetech.com
From: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@olivetech.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term throughput lift for product launch

Alice —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the beta launch. Short answer: we can do a temporary throughput lift and offer a tiered rebate tied to the net-new volume you bring during the promo window.

Quick outline:
- Temporary uplift: reserve an additional 2.5M tokens/min for 48–72 hours (we’ll need a confirmed window).
- Billing: we can apply a per-token surcharge for the uplifted capacity OR invoice the overrun at a discounted overage rate.
- Volume rebate: if total month-over-month tokens exceed 200M, we can rebate X% of overrun charges (proposal in attached PDF).

Ben — looping you and Laury for pricing/approval. Alice — can you confirm the exact launch window (start/end UTC) and whether you want committed burst capacity or on-demand uplift?

Best,

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term throughput lift for product launch

Quick notes for internal:
- Proposed schedule: 2025-07-19T16:00Z to 2025-07-22T04:00Z (72 hours) — need customer confirmation.
- Pricing options:
  A) On-demand overrun billed at 1.8x standard overage rate (fastest, no commitment)
  B) Pre-reserved burst (24–72h) at 1.4x overage rate + volume rebate tiers if monthly >200M (5% rebate), >300M (8% rebate)
- Need finance sign-off for rebate tiers. Laura, can you confirm margin impact and whether a 5% rebate on overrun charges is acceptable for this account size?

Attaching the draft rebate schedule and the June usage CSV (redacted for PII).

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise
ben@redwood.com
From: Alice Monroe <alice@olivetech.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: ethan@olivetech.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term throughput lift for product launch

Camila/Ben —

Thanks for the fast responses. Confirming the window: 2025-07-19 16:00 UTC through 2025-07-22 16:00 UTC (72 hours). Olive prefers option B (pre-reserved burst) to avoid throttling risk, and the rebate tiers look reasonable — we’re targeting ~250–280M tokens for July with the promo.

Please proceed with the reserved burst quote and add the rebate tier for >200M at 5%. We’ll need a short MPA addendum and a PO issued by Friday 18th. Can you send a DocuSign link for the addendum and a one-line invoice for the burst reservation? Also attach the proposed rebate schedule.

Looking forward —

Alice
